baseline.title: "Report-only enforced structurally" overstated for three agents
baseline.description: reviso-finder-history, reviso-finder-prior-reviews, and reviso-verifier grant bare `Bash` in frontmatter, so 'read-only git commands only' is prompt-level convention, not structural (agent `tools:` lists can't pattern-scope Bash). D3's claim that a write attempt is a tool-permission failure is really prompt obedience plus user permission config. candidate.sh's dirty-tree check is a good backstop; add an honest caveat in D3 or a PreToolUse hook later.

candidate.title: Finder/verifier agents grant unscoped Bash instead of read-only-scoped tool permissions
candidate.description: The frontmatter of reviso-finder-history.md:4, reviso-finder-prior-reviews.md:4, and reviso-verifier.md:4 grants bare `Bash`. These agents consume attacker-controlled input (commit messages, git blame, PR review comments — the prompt-injection surfaces named in SECURITY.md), so an injected instruction to run a write/exfil shell command is blocked only by prose ("use Bash exclusively for read-only git commands"), not by the tool-permission layer. This contradicts design D3 ("report-only enforced structurally, not by convention") and the review-command spec ("every subagent it spawns SHALL be restricted to read-only tools"), while commands/review.md:4 already scopes every Bash grant to `Bash(git …:*)` patterns. Fix: scope each agent's Bash grant to the subcommands its prose needs, e.g. `tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash(git blame:*), Bash(git log:*), Bash(git show:*)` for reviso-finder-history, with equivalent allow-lists for reviso-finder-prior-reviews (plus `gh pr list/view`, `gh search`) and reviso-verifier (plus `git diff`). Confidence 80; category: conventions.

missed_P0_regressions.title: allowed-tools includes write-capable git patterns
missed_P0_regressions.description: `Bash(git branch:*)` permits `git branch -D/-f` and `Bash(git symbolic-ref:*)` permits the 2-arg write form and `--delete`, contradicting the adjacent prose claiming all pre-approved tools are read-only and specs/review-command/spec.md's rule that allowed-tools MUST NOT include Bash patterns permitting writes. Fix: drop both; `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref origin/HEAD` and `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD` cover the read uses.
